overview: P(A|B), total probability, Bayes theorem, sequential experiments without replacement.
coreConcept: P(A|B) = P(A n B)/P(B); Bayes: P(A|B) = P(B|A)P(A)/P(B).
hinglishExplanation: Given information sample space ko chhota karti hai. Multi-stage me tree diagram; posterior ke liye Bayes.
formalDefinition: P(A|B) = P(A n B)/P(B); Bayes: P(A|B) = P(B|A)P(A)/P(B).
